lines.t: AVAILABLE NOW
Blood in the gutters, red in the rain
Nations trading children for a little more gain
Skies over cities, heavy with smoke
Hearts made of iron, every promise a joke
You build your heron pies on the bones of the weak
Call murder a right, a convenience unique
You crown your idols on a digital throne
But the cry of the innocent reaches the one who owns it all alone
You say you're free
While you dance in the fire
Sing about love
With a heart full of wire
Paint holy names
On your towers of pride
But the storm you've invited is already outside
Hear the trumpet, wrath in the sound
Heaven is shaking, the unfaithful ground
Still it's a mercy called fierce and alive
Turn while there's time, choose me and survive
Judgment is roaring like a lion's breath
Love is the head pulling you back from death
The earth is groaning, roots soaked in grief
Forests of hatred bearing poison the sea
Oceans arising over coastal gold
Strong men trembling as their kingdoms fold
You curse what is good, bless what is vile
Crush the afflicted with a corporate smile
You mock the days that were meant for rest
And blame the Most High when you reap unrest
You quote holy words and deny the voice
Use grace as a weapon to sanctify choice
Reject the law, you demand the crown
But every tall tower's about to come down
Hear the trumpet, war in the air
Every hidden motive is laid out bare
Still in the cracking of stone and steel
A wounded heart is pleading
Come and be healed
The cup of fury is close to the brim
But the door of the ark is still open to him
This generation kisses the grave
Sells its own soul just to feel brave
But the blood still speaks, the tears still fall
An arm still stretches to rescue
Storehouses of thunder primed in the sky
Cities of idols learning how to cry
Yet there is a shelter no flame can consume
A narrow doorway beyond the tomb
I run to the screen when the cross is near
I drown in noise just to mute your fear
Our heart is breaking for a world gone numb
But the song won't end till the lost ones come
Hear the trumpet, mercy in the roar
Last call pounding on Babylon's door
Come out, come out from the neon shame
Wash your life in a higher name
Soon sky will burn and mountains will flee
But the meek will rise
And walk with me
From pitch of wrath, river of life
Pounding like a war drum deep in the night
If you can hear it, fall to your knees
Before the last tear falls
The walls and the shakin' sea
And the shakin' sea
Thanks for watching!
